```sql
SELECT DISTINCT 
    p.ID,
    p.Birthday,
    p.Diagnosis
FROM main."Laboratory" l
JOIN main."Patient" p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE YEAR(l."Date") = 1997
  AND l.GOT >= 60
ORDER BY p.ID
```
